newsitem.title: CANADA: Royalty trust using Amoco Canada assets filed.
newsitem.headline: Royalty trust using Amoco Canada assets filed.

text.p: PrimeWest Energy Inc said on Monday it filed a prospectus for the initial public offering 24.9 million units of PrimeWest Energy Trust for C$10 each.
PrimeWest said the trust units would be paid for on an installment basis with C$6 payable on closing and C$4 within the next year. Closing is scheduled for October 17.
The trust will use the net proceeds from the offering to acquire a royalty from PrimeWest in certain oil and gas properties purchased from Amoco Corp unit Canada Petroleum Co Ltd C$241.4 million.

The properties to be acquired by PrimeWest include interests in several major oil and natural gas fields in western Canada in 11 areas. The properties contain long-life reserves with a proved plus 50-percent probable reserve life index of 12.4 years, the company said.
It said about 36.7 million barrels of oil equivalent of remaining reserves were attributed to those properties.

Working interest production being acquired totals about 4,583 barrels per day of oil and natural gas liquids, 36 million cubic feet per day of natural gas and 200 long tons per day of sulphur, PrimeWest said.
The company said it was seeking to assume operatorship of the properties from Amoco Canada pending agreement from other working interest owners.
An underwriting group co-led by CIBC Wood Gundy Securities Inc and RBC Dominion Securities Inc was managing the offering, it said.
